data.name: Milin
data.gender_notes: Milin is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Milin is derived from the Sanskrit word 'milana', which means 'meeting' or 'union'. In Hindu mythology, Milin is the name of a celestial being who facilitates the union of Shiva and Parvati during their annual reunion, Mahashivratri. This name is bestowed upon a child to symbolize the divine connection and blessings from the gods.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine connection and blessings from the gods.
data.etymology: Milin belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Path of the Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Milin total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
